nodes.label: graphify usage rules (project CLAUDE.md)
nodes.rationale: Query the graph before grep or raw file reads to save context; run graphify update after code changes to keep the graph current; large graph.json diffs in PRs are expected churn.

nodes.label: CacheAdapter interface
nodes.rationale: Abstract the cache behind an interface so providers can be swapped via config without changing API routes or frontend.

nodes.label: Upstash Redis (chosen cache backend)
nodes.rationale: Fastest to add; serverless pay-per-request key-value store that fits entity-by-ID and events-by-year keys.

nodes.label: Framer Motion / GSAP animations
nodes.rationale: Fluid, cinematic transitions that give the site an animated storybook feel.

nodes.label: GraphNode and generic edge model
nodes.rationale: Treat all data as nodes and edges so new node types or relation types need no schema migration.

nodes.label: Wikidata (primary data source)
nodes.rationale: Free, no-auth, CORS-friendly public data with deep royal genealogy, so the client can fetch directly without a backend initially.

nodes.label: Slide-over detail panel (chosen)
nodes.rationale: Chosen over right sidebar, bottom sheet and modal for overlay behavior and dismissibility, with more space for content.

nodes.label: d3-hierarchy (layout only)
nodes.rationale: Minimal change and small bundle, but tree() expects one parent per node so a primary parent must be chosen for the DAG.

nodes.label: React Flow + dagre (recommended)
nodes.rationale: Directly addresses edge clipping and image misalignment, keeps custom node UI, and is widely maintained; switch to elkjs if layout quality is insufficient.

nodes.label: React Flow + elkjs
nodes.rationale: More powerful and configurable layout for complex trees with many crossing edges; heavier than dagre.

nodes.label: reactflow-family-tree package
nodes.rationale: Purpose-built for family trees but has low adoption and limited custom UI; requires an adapter from TreeNode.

nodes.label: TreeNode data model (parents and children DAG)
nodes.norm_label: treenode data model (parents and children dag)
